We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need number of carbonyl groups. Could also be deduced from IR: strong peak around 1700 cm-1 indicates carbonyl. But we need count.

We have no SMILES. The system likely has a sample at hand (the compound). We can use IR spectra tool to detect carbonyl peaks. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbon shifts (~190-220 ppm). Could also use HSQC but not needed.

We should first get IR spectra. Use ir_spectra tool.
